assignments.library_title: ECO Kutno: drilling of geothermal wells Kutno GT-1 and GT-2

bases.Drilling: TED 725171-2026, published 20 October 2026, expressly covers drilling, casing, cementing and completion of Kutno GT-1 and GT-2, together with hydrogeological tests and site restoration, as one construction package.

excluded.label: Equipment
excluded.reason: Casing and other materials sit inside the drilling package. The notice also includes construction and installation of a thermal-water discharge tank. That tank is part of the same package and is not a separately procured equipment supply.

excluded.label: Engineering & Services
excluded.reason: Hydrogeological tests are integral to the drilling package. Routine tests inside that package do not add Engineering & Services.

assignments.basis: Drilling only. The package is wider than drill pipe and routine tests, and a drilling audience tag remains the defensible single label.
assignments.library_summary: Drilling, casing, cementing, completion and hydrogeological tests for two wells for a planned geothermal heating plant; GT-2 design option and right to drop GT-2.

provenance.note: Independent review of the TED description: drilling, casing, cementing, completion, hydrogeological tests, site restoration, and a thermal-water discharge tank in the same package.

provenance.ref: Audience-tag review, 8 November 2026, final delta GREEN at 00:57 CET

assignments.library_title: HVC: framework agreement for heat exchangers for geothermal projects

bases.Equipment: TED 726565-2026, published 21 October 2026, procures design, engineering, manufacturing, transportation and delivery of vertical plate-and-frame heat exchangers in two portfolio lots, Westland and Slochteren. The lots are represented by the Wippolderlaan and Alton datasheets. The notice does not limit the framework to exactly two plants.

excluded.label: Engineering & Services
excluded.reason: Design and engineering in this notice are the ordinary work of supplying the heat exchangers. They are not a separate engineering deliverable.

excluded.label: Drilling
excluded.reason: Nothing in the supply package is a drilling, well-construction or well-intervention contract.

excluded.label: Project owners & developers
excluded.reason: The buyer being a project owner does not make this a project-development or funding instrument.

assignments.basis: Equipment only. Two portfolio lots, not a count of plant sites. Integral product engineering does not add a second tag.
assignments.library_summary: Plate-and-frame heat exchangers for HVC's geothermal production plants; lots Westland (est. EUR 3.5m) and Slochteren (est. EUR 5m).

provenance.note: Independent review: two portfolio lots, Westland and Slochteren, not a statement that there are exactly two plants.

provenance.ref: Audience-tag review, 8 November 2026, final delta GREEN at 00:57 CET

assignments.library_title: Energies du Grand Paris: project-management framework for the Paris heat networks (incl. geothermal production sites)

bases.Engineering & Services: TED 755201-2026, published 30 October 2026, is a framework for conception and supervision of renewal, modernisation, development and densification works on the Paris heat networks.

excluded.label: Drilling
excluded.reason: Future geothermal production sites are context for the design and supervision. This notice does not procure the drilling.

excluded.label: Equipment
excluded.reason: Networks and substations describe the system being designed and supervised. They are not a supply contract for equipment.

assignments.basis: Engineering & Services only. Downstream drilling or equipment contracts are not tagged from this notice.
assignments.library_summary: Framework for maîtrise d'œuvre; about 8 geothermal/renewable production sites, 200 km hot-water and 25 km steam network, 2,900 hot-water and 664 steam substations.

provenance.note: Independent review of the TED description: conception and supervision, not equipment or drilling procurement.

provenance.ref: Audience-tag review, 8 November 2026, final delta GREEN at 00:57 CET

assignments.library_title: Île-de-France ERDF call 2026: geothermal heat and cold
assignments.eligibility_caveat: The audience tag does not mean that every reader or every project developer is individually eligible. Programme conditions still apply.

bases.Project owners & developers: Call PDF §2, printed pages 5–6, supports creation or extension of geothermal heat and cold production and distribution installations. §3.1, printed page 6, lists eligible project proponents, including operators and representatives of local authorities and their groupings, public establishments, local public and mixed-economy companies, mixed syndicates, micro, small and medium enterprises and listed groupings, social and solidarity-economy structures, associations, foundations and social landlords (OPHLM).

excluded.label: Drilling
excluded.reason: Drilling that a funded project may later contain is not a drilling contract in this call.

excluded.label: Equipment
excluded.reason: Equipment that a funded project may later buy is not an equipment-supply notice.

excluded.label: Engineering & Services
excluded.reason: Engineering that a funded project may later procure is not a services notice.

assignments.basis: Project owners & developers only. §2 and §3.1 together show a development and funding instrument for project proponents. The tag is not an individual eligibility decision.
assignments.library_summary: Regional ERDF call for geothermal heat and cold production and distribution.

provenance.note: Independent review of the original PDF: §2 printed pages 5–6 and §3.1 printed page 6.

provenance.ref: Audience-tag review, 8 November 2026, final delta GREEN at 00:57 CET
